message.content: On September 16, 2026, LiHua expressed enthusiasm for the idea of incorporating improvisational solos into their practice sessions, describing it as "a great idea" that would make their sessions more fun and creative. LiHua believes that improvisation will help them grow as musicians and encourages spontaneity during these sessions. The discussion also indicates that LiHua is looking forward to seeing what everyone brings to the table during these improvised sessions.
